results.title: Tariff Resources and Strategies | GaMEP at Georgia Tech
results.content:
As global trade evolves, manufacturers — either directly or indirectly — may face new challenges, such as adjusting pricing strategies, disrupting supply chains, and rising production expenses.

However, you can manage your risk and reduce your tariff burden through expert guidance and strategic solutions:

## Alternative Tariff Strategies [...] Reshoring: Consider automation opportunities and domestic suppliers (including those who can expand their production).
 Nearshoring: Take advantage of duty-free imports through Mexico.
 Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States Chapter 98 and Chapter 99: Eliminate or reduce duties for qualifying products.
 Bonded warehouses: Store imported products while deferring duties until they leave the facility (quarterly harbor maintenance fees apply). [...] ## GaMEP Expertise

 Supply chain assessment: We evaluate your supply chain — from raw material to finished product — to identify risks and opportunities.
 Supplier scouting: We search for and connect you with qualified domestic suppliers.

 Process improvement: We apply lean practices to improve production and reduce costs.
 Technology automation: We analyze and help implement appropriate technologies.
